mentions.name: fxdax
mentions.description: A port of Fuchsia's fxfs file system to Linux, built on top of a novel virtio device that stores file data in object storage. It is intended as a file system for VMs that supports DAX to avoid page cache duplication while maintaining high performance.
mentions.problem: VM file systems duplicate page cache; fxdax supports DAX to avoid this duplication while maintaining high performance.
